sourceRecords.title: Heavy-Lift Marine Operator, French Port Team Up on Floating Wind Launching Solutions
sourceRecords.sourceText: OffshoreWIND.biz reported that BOA and BrestPort agreed to collaborate on floating offshore wind turbine launching methods from port facilities into open water and related port infrastructure. The source states that the work will use BrestPort marine renewable energy terminal facilities and BOA semi-submersible barges and offshore engineering resources.
